{{Infobox character |games =FOTV, FORPG |race =[[Human]] |image =FOTV Season1 ep1 Honcho.jpg |gender =Male |role =Head honcho |family =Unnamed father |status =Unknown, possibly deceased |location =[[The Ghoul's grave]] (last seen) |affiliation = |TV actor =[[Mykelti Williamson]] |stunt double=[[Brandon McClary]] |special ={{SPECIAL|6,6,5,6,5,5,4}} {{Icon|FORPG}} |tag skills =Melee Weapons 2{{dot}} Small Guns 3 {{Icon|FORPG}} |level =3 {{Icon|FORPG}} }} '''Honcho''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Much of Honcho's backstory is shrouded in mystery; however, his father was an acquaintance of the Ghoul.[[Slim (TV series)|Slim]]: ''"Shit. You're telling me this supreme badass we're looking for is a godforsaken mutant?"''
Honcho: ''"Have some respec'. That's your prospective coworker you's talking about and our ticket to a big payoff."''
Slim: ''"Thought you said you knew this guy."''
Honcho: ''"I said I knew of him. My pop worked with him once."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Honcho with [[Slim (TV series)|Slim]] watches as [[Biggie]] uses his [[Junk Jet (TV series)|Junk Jet]] to kill the [[Dom Pedro's guard|guard]] stationed outside where [[the Ghoul]] is said to be at.{{fotv|1|1}} Inside the compound, Slim asks Honcho where they'll find the Ghoul, and he answers that they'll search for the fresh one. Upon entering the graveyard area, Honcho informs his two lackeys about how [[Dom Pedro (character)|Dom Pedro]] digs up the Ghoul once a year to cut some pieces of him and then reburies him.[[Slim (TV series)|Slim]]: ''"How do we know which grave?"''
Honcho: ''"Well, Slim, we look for the fresh one. Dom Pedro has our friend dug up once a year. Cuts some pieces off and puts him right back in the ground."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) The moment they find [[the Ghoul's grave]], Biggie curses and complains that the person they're looking for is a [[Ghoul|mutant]], which Honcho snaps at the accusation. Honcho claims that the Ghoul is their prospective co-worker and will help them get a big payoff, before clarifying to Slim that his father worked with the Ghoul once. This perplexes Slim, who then asks how long the Ghoul has been buried underground, with Biggie then chiming in, asking about the possibility of the Ghoul being [[Feral ghoul (TV series)|feral]]. Honcho then claims that's why they have a [[chicken]] in their possession, which a feral ghoul cannot tolerate, and that if he goes for it, they'll kill him. With the chicken close by, Biggie and Slim dig up the Ghoul's grave and pull up his coffin. Once that is done, at a safe distance, Honcho pulls on a rope to open up the Ghoul's coffin. Moments later, the Ghoul exits his coffin and, after gaining his composure, remarks that he's now a part of the Amish production of the Count of Monte Cristo, or it's the weirdest circle of jerks he's ever been invited to. Honcho laughs at the Ghoul's remark, introduces himself, and states that he doesn't know them, but the Ghoul curtly remarks that he does not. As the Ghoul picks up their chicken, Biggie asks if it's alright to shoot him, but Honcho tells Biggie to shut the fuck up. Honcho then tries to negotiate with the Ghoul, offering him a huge score for the Ghoul and his own men. He then shows a drawing of the two targets [[Siggi Wilzig]] and [[CX404]], who are [[Enclave]] defectors. The Ghoul expresses no interest, but Honcho claims that he'd be interested in the person they're trying to reach, [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]. It's Honcho's next comment about where the Ghoul was originally from that triggers him. Upset that the Ghoul gave him an attitude, Honcho threatens to put the Ghoul back into the hole by his lackeys so Dom Pedro can deal with him for another thirty years. The Ghoul then eyed both Biggie and Slim and told them that when people say that when it's the last job, it typically means their hearts are not in it. Then, he remarks that it probably never was, but finishes by confessing that he does it because he loves playing the game. The Ghoul then tossed the end of the rope with a hook on it that opened up his coffin at Honcho and yanked him toward it. Regaining his composure and footing, the Ghoul informs that Honcho was right about one thing and that meeting him was his last job and killed him by pushing his coffin back into the ground. ==Personality== Honcho acted like a headstrong, no-nonsense boss toward his men. On the other hand, when it came to interacting with the Ghoul, he spoke slyly as a way to persuade him to join him in the hunt for Wilzig and his dog. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|My pop worked with him once.|About the Ghoul}} ==Notes== The names of Honcho and his gang are descriptive of themselves. Honcho is the head honcho of the gang, [[Biggie]] is very big, and [[Slim (TV series)|Slim]] is quite skinny. ==Appearances== Honcho appears only {{in|FOTV}}. His gameplay statistics appear in the ''[[Fallout 2d20: NPC Pack - Hollywood Heroes]]'' expansion pack for ''[[Fallout: The Roleplaying Game]]''. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[category:Fallout: The Roleplaying Game characters]]
